descripcion_es: Sustantivos que nombran ideas, procesos y cualidades.
resumen: Sustantivos abstractos de registro culto (rationale, framework, trade-off, outcome) que permiten hablar de ideas con precisión. Son la base del estilo nominal de informes, ensayos y exposiciones.

explicacion.texto: El inglés culto condensa ideas en sustantivos: en lugar de «because prices went up, people bought less» se escribe «the rise in prices led to a decline in consumption». Dominar estos sustantivos, con sus preposiciones, da precisión y registro.

filas: The rationale for the reform is clear.
The EU provides a legal framework.
There is a trade-off between growth and stability.
The outcome of the vote is uncertain.
The main drawback is the cost.
They studied the feasibility of the project.
There is growing awareness of the issue.
The scope of the study is limited.
The survey shows a clear bias.
The book offers insight into Roman life.
The model rests on several assumptions.
Their commitment to reform is weak.
There is reluctance to raise taxes.
The resilience of the banking system.
With hindsight, the decision was a mistake.

items: Fíjate en la preposición: reliance ON, insight INTO, commitment TO, rationale FOR, shift TOWARDS.
Muchos son incontables (awareness, accountability, leverage): no llevan «a» ni plural.
«Consistent» = coherente; no significa «consistente» (sólido, que es «solid» o «substantial»).

ejemplos.frase: With hindsight, we should have left earlier.
ejemplos.traduccion: Visto ahora, deberíamos habernos ido antes.

ejemplos.frase: The main drawback of living in the centre is the noise.
ejemplos.traduccion: El principal inconveniente de vivir en el centro es el ruido.

ejemplos.frase: Her novel offers real insight into family life in the 1950s.
ejemplos.traduccion: Su novela permite comprender de verdad la vida familiar en los años cincuenta.

ejemplos.frase: There is still some reluctance to accept the new rules.
ejemplos.traduccion: Todavía hay cierta reticencia a aceptar las nuevas normas.

ejemplos.frase: The coach praised the team's resilience after the defeat.
ejemplos.traduccion: El entrenador elogió la capacidad de reacción del equipo tras la derrota.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: The dependence of foreign energy is a risk.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: Dependence on foreign energy is a risk.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: The building's foundations are very consistent.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: The building's foundations are very solid.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: «Consistente» (sólido, firme) es «solid»; «consistent» significa coherente o constante.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: We need a bigger conscience of the problem.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: We need greater awareness of the problem.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: «Conciencia» de algo es «awareness»; «conscience» es la conciencia moral.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: The compromise of the government with the reform.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: The government's commitment to the reform.

ejercicios.frase: Europe must reduce its reliance ___ imported energy.

ejercicios.enunciado: Completa con un sustantivo (perspectiva a posteriori).
ejercicios.frase: With ___, it is easy to see what went wrong.
There is always a ___ between flexibility and security.
The campaign aims to raise conscience of the risks of smoking.
respuestas: The campaign aims to raise awareness of the risks of smoking.
ejercicios.explicacion: «Concienciar» es «raise awareness»; «conscience» es la conciencia moral.

ejercicios.enunciado: Completa con un sustantivo (rendición de cuentas).
ejercicios.frase: Voters are demanding more transparency and ___ from their leaders.
The book gives us a fascinating ___ into the mind of a genius.
The government reaffirmed its commitment ___ the climate goals.
Before investing, they carried out a ___ study.
ejercicios.explicacion: Un estudio de viabilidad es «feasibility study».

ejercicios.frase: The only ___ of the flat is that it has no lift.
There is a growing dependence of tourism in the islands.
respuestas: There is a growing dependence on tourism in the islands.
There is a growing reliance on tourism in the islands.

ejercicios.frase: The model is based on the ___ that people behave rationally.
We are seeing a major ___ towards remote work.
Small countries have little ___ in international negotiations.
There was some ___ among members to accept the new rules.

respuestas: The rationale for the reform is not clear
